gemini.performance_metric: acquired whole by Brookfield in July 2016 at $18.25 per share in cash and deregistered
gemini.rationale: The slice documents that Rouse Properties was acquired whole by Brookfield in July 2016 and subsequently deregistered, ending its public reporting. There is no documented evidence of product/process disruption (p4) or process/organization fracture (p5) during the post-deal period, as the public record bounds at the acquisition.

grok.performance_metric: whole-company cash acquisition at $18.25/share July 2016; deregistered
grok.rationale: The slice documents no product/process interface disruption: the FY2015 10-K and subsequent 8-Ks report only financial results (losses then one year of net income aided by a debt-extinguishment gain) and the later whole-company sale, with no realized product-line or operating-process incoherence. Likewise no process/organization fracture is documented over the post-2012 window; the CEO/CFO resignations and conversion to LLC occurred at the Effective Time of the separate July 2016 Brookfield merger as ordinary closing mechanics, not as an integration breakdown of operations against organization. Absence of evidence for either pathway is therefore coded 0.

openai.performance_metric: FY2015 net income of $41.6 million, including a $26.6 million debt-extinguishment gain
openai.rationale: The realized record documents annual financial results and the 2016 acquisition and deregistration, but no product-line or operating-process incoherence, so p4 is 0. The CEO and CFO departed without cause at the 2016 merger closing, but the slice does not document an operations-versus-organization integration breakdown over time; therefore p5 is 0.
